author: Brandons209
description: Log messages, dms, attachments, guild updates (roles, channels, bans, kicks etc) and be able to retrieve these logs for review. Saves these right to disk and customize then to rotate log files. Tracks user's stats; how many messages they send, how many are bot commands, time spent in VC, and moderator actions against them. Also provides an upgraded userinfo command that gives these stats alongside the information Red's userinfo command gives.
install_msg: Thank you for using this cog! First set the database backend using [p]logset backend, then setup what you want logged using [p]logset. Once done run [p]logset sync in a guild to download all available data to database. Also, set bot prefixes per guild using [p]logset prefixes for proper user stat tracking.
short: Log messages, audit actions, and track user statistics.
end_user_data_statement: Depending on setup, can log user messages, voice channel activity, audit actions in guilds, activity statistics per guild, user name changes, and any moderation actions per guild.
